title: The Credit Card Trap
segments: A twenty-four percent credit card is like an investment that guarantees you lose twenty-four percent.
Say you owe six thousand dollars and only pay the minimum. A big chunk of every payment goes to interest, so the balance barely moves. It can take over a decade to clear.
Two ways to fight it. Avalanche: pay the highest interest rate first. Snowball: pay the smallest balance first. Both work. Pick one today.
Call your card company and ask for a lower rate. And build a small cushion so surprise bills never land on the card.
Send this to a friend who needs it. Follow for more.
description: How credit card interest keeps balances high—and two practical ways to pay debt down. Not financial advice.
